_comment: Frozen labelled cases for vault subject-relevance (candidate 329 P1). Each case is (topic, corpus, bullet, expected) drawn from a REAL run - do NOT edit an existing case casually, because changing it invalidates comparison against earlier eval runs. Add a new entry instead. `corpus` is the run's operator key facts + signal headlines, NOT the angle: the angle is the ambiguous thing being disambiguated. This file is JSON - never run `ruff format` on it.

cases.topic: GTA 6 Leak and Wolverine Rage Signal a Cultural Backlash
cases.corpus: To find the Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker, the parent company of Rockstar Games has resorted to filing subpoenas in a US court to force Microsoft and Discord to hand over their records. Rockstar Games Reportedly Remains In The Dark About Who's Leaking GTA 6.
cases.bullet: Rockstar Games confirms the leak investigation is ongoing.
cases.why: The company at the centre of the story. Names no franchise anchor, which is why the anchor gate dropped it.
